messages:
marya: quick check — i pushed a very short RN blurb to the draft doc. trying to keep the internal announce to 2 bullets + one call-to-action. can someone eyeball?
kevin: will do. what are we calling out for rollbacks? i want a clear metric for ops.
sarah: i can compact copy. put the CTA as 'observe canary for 30m, escalate if latency regresses >30%'. shorter is better for the blast.
ops-oncall: agreed on the CTA. for rollback gating we use: CPU >= 75% OR request_error_rate >= 2% sustained for 5m. add those exact thresholds.
marya: adding those. also need a pin note for the model artifact — can we pin the serving tag so the blast doesn't auto-switch?
kevin: pin request: `model/redwood-realtime:2026-03-21-quant-v1` — and fallback to `model/redwood-realtime:2026-02-09-fast` if canary fails.
sarah: ok i'll weave into the snippet. proposing final internal snippet: "Release notes (internal): 1) Updated default batching config to reduce p99 latency by ~12% for short chats. 2) Canary rolling now; watch latency and error-rate. CTA: monitor canary for 30m, escalate to #eng-oncall if gating criteria met (CPU >=75% or errors >=2% for 5m). Model pinned: model/redwood-realtime:2026-03-21-quant-v1; fallback: 2026-02-09-fast."
ops-oncall: add deploybot cue to the note: `deploybot:tag=internal_snippet,quiet_window=00:30` so deploybot threads link to the pinned message.
marya: can someone trigger a quick canary dry-run with that tag? want to confirm the deploybot summary shows the pinned tag.
kevin: launching canary now. small heads-up: there's a known perf variance on west1 during warmup; we'll watch baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary start request accepted.
```
canary id: cb-20260321-91
model: model/redwood-realtime:2026-03-21-quant-v1
variant: canary (5%)
start_ts: 1737990300
```
ops-oncall: looks good. i'm standing by for metrics — will ping if thresholds hit.
sarah: final copy below, ready to paste to internal blast channel: "Heads up — rolling canary for batching perf change. Expected improvement: ~12% p99 for short sessions. Monitor: latency and errors. Rollback triggers: CPU >=75% or errors >=2% for 5m. Model pinned to model/redwood-realtime:2026-03-21-quant-v1; fallback: 2026-02-09-fast. Quiet window: 30m. Ops oncall: @ops-oncall.
Links: staging smoke results: https://internal.ci/runs/9876, deploybot canary: cb-20260321-91"
marya: :eyes: looks great. main ask — after 30m, if everything green, i'll push the public RN blurb. can we add a single sentence for product: "no user-facing change expected" ?
kevin: add it. :shipit:
sarah: pasted to the internal announce thread and pinned. deploy-bot tag attached. i'll keep the snippet locked in the doc for public copy followup.
marya: thanks all — i'll take care of the public microcopy after the canary. will update this thread with final rollforward/rollback decision.
ops-oncall: standby monitoring. will post metrics summary at +15m and +30m.
deploy-bot: Canary health update (15m):
```
cb-20260321-91: p50 45ms (+1%), p95 180ms (-10%), p99 320ms (-12%)
errors: 0.3%
CPU: 62%
status: healthy
```
marya: nice. continuing to hold. will schedule public RN for +35m if +30m looks similar.
kevin: noted. will prepare the change log entry with the pinned artifact and a reminder about the fallback.
sarah: final ack from docs: good to publish. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: 30m summary posted to thread: all green, no action needed. rolling to broader fleet per plan.
marya: rolling. closing internal announce thread once public blurb goes out. thanks everyone!
